fact: Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 31 per cent of tertiary graduates in Rwanda in 2022, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 28.8 per cent of tertiary graduates in Rwanda in 2023, by UNESCO's series.
Graduates in science, technology, engineering and mathematics were 29.5 per cent of tertiary graduates in Rwanda in 2024, by UNESCO's series.
